en.headline: Man arrested over suspected forged fire extinguisher certificate
en.dek: A 62-year-old contractor was arrested after investigators found severe corrosion on an extinguisher that had been certified as functional at a Lantau restaurant last year.
body: A 62-year-old man believed to be a registered contractor was arrested on Wednesday on suspicion of forgery relating to a fire service installation, the Fire Services Department said.

Investigators opened the case after a fire extinguisher exploded in a Lantau restaurant in September, injuring a woman. They discovered that the contractor had issued a certificate in February last year stating the extinguisher was functioning properly and met departmental requirements. Officers later found the unit had suffered severe corrosion and suspected it had not been inspected in person.

The case was referred to police for criminal investigation. The man was released on bail pending further inquiries. Acting assistant divisional officer Choy Lit-pong said the department has been checking certificates issued by contractors and is not ruling out requiring additional proof when safety certificates are submitted in future.

zh.headline: 疑虛報滅火筒檢查證書 62歲承辦商被捕
zh.dek: 消防處調查大嶼山食肆滅火筒爆炸後，發現承辦商去年發出的證書聲稱器材正常，惟其後發現嚴重銹蝕，懷疑未曾親身檢查。
body: 消防處表示，一名相信為註冊承辦商的62歲男子星期三因涉嫌偽造與消防裝置有關的文件被捕。
調查源於去年9月大嶼山一間食肆的滅火筒爆炸，一名女子受傷。調查人員發現承辦商於去年2月向食肆發出證書，聲稱滅火筒運作正常並符合部門要求。其後檢查發現器材嚴重銹蝕，懷疑承辦商並未親身檢查。
案件已轉交警方作刑事調查，男子獲准保釋候查。署理助理區長蔡烈邦表示，部門一直根據承辦商發出的證書進行巡查，不排除日後要求承辦商提交安全證書時提供更多證明。
